description: Monthly Transportation Statistics is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Tranportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Monthly Transportation Statistics is a compilation of national statistics on transportation. The Bureau of Transportation Statistics brings together the latest data from across the Federal government and transportation industry. Monthly Transportation Statistics contains over 50 time series from nearly two dozen data sources. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 136 columns, among them State and Local Government Construction Spending - Lighting, Air Safety - General Aviation Fatalities, Index, Heavy truck sales SAAR (millions), U.S. marketing air carriers on-time performance (percent), Auto sales SAAR (millions). The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Tranportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
